items.invariant: Actor isolation prevents data races, not stale assumptions across await.
items.applies_because: An actor method suspends before committing shared state.
items.challenge: Interleave two calls so the later request finishes first; trace state before and after each suspension.

items.invariant: Results from superseded asynchronous work must not overwrite the current owner state.
items.applies_because: Multiple tasks write the same result property.
items.challenge: Identify what proves a completing task is still the latest relevant task.

unknowns: The UI owner and cancellation policy are intentionally omitted.
